description:
Live price, order book depth, extremes and 7d/30d change for one skin. The compact price card the rust.wiki Discord bot's /price command shows, as data. All prices are integer USD
cents: `price_cents` (the canonical wiki price - Steam's lowest sell order, or the highest buy order when
nothing is listed), `ask_cents` and `bid_cents` (the two sides of Steam's book), `sell_orders`/`buy_orders`
(how many orders stand on each side), `sell_ladder` and `buy_ladder` (the top five price levels on each side,
best first, as `{price, quantity}`), `ath_cents`/`atl_cents` (the skin's all-time high and low from Steam's
sale history), `change_7d`/`change_30d` (percent move of today's price against our closest Steam price reading
7 and 30 days back; null without enough history) and `sales_30d` (units sold on Steam in the last 30 days,
null when none). Plus `name`, `icon_url`, `market_hash_name` and `category`. Cached for 5 minutes.
name: get_skin_price
title: Live price, order book depth, extremes and 7d/30d change for one skin
